title: Web Designer
description:
About the company:

Our client is a digital-focused organization that provides creative branding and online presence solutions. They specialize in helping businesses elevate their identity and build high-performing websites across modern platforms.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a full-time Web Designer with strong branding capabilities. The ideal candidate excels in creating visually compelling brand identities and translating them into clean, functional, and modern website designs. Experience designing for platforms such as Webflow, Shopify, or similar CMS/eCommerce tools is highly valued.

Responsibilities of the role:

• Develop high-quality, user-centric website designs aligned with brand guidelines.

• Create and refine brand visuals, including color palettes, typography, and style systems.

• Collaborate with clients or internal teams to understand project goals and brand direction.

• Design responsive layouts optimized for various devices.

• Work with Webflow, Shopify, or other platforms to ensure design feasibility and proper handoff.

• Maintain consistent brand identity across all digital materials.

• Provide creative input and propose design improvements as needed.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience in website design and branding.

• Strong portfolio showcasing brand development and modern website design projects.

• Experience designing for Webflow, Shopify, or similar platforms.

• Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Illustrator, or equivalent.

• Understanding of UI/UX best practices and responsive design principles.

• Ability to translate abstract ideas into clear, aesthetic visual concepts.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with front-end fundamentals (HTML/CSS) for better design-to-dev collaboration.

• Experience with creating design systems.

• Knowledge of eCommerce design best practices.

• Ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, project-driven environments.

Personality:

• Highly creative with a strong eye for detail.

• Proactive and able to work independently.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to receive and integrate feedback.

• Organized, reliable, and deadline-oriented.

Software & Tools

• Figma

• Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, XD)

• Webflow / Shopify (design-focused use)

• Additional design or prototyping tools as needed

English Level:

C2, Native, C1

Schedule:

9-5 EST

Experience designing for platforms such as Webflow, Shopify, or similar CMS/eCommerce tools is highly valued.

• Develop high-quality, user-centric website designs aligned with brand guidelines.

• Create and refine brand visuals, including color palettes, typography, and style systems.

• Design responsive layouts optimized for various devices.

• Work with Webflow, Shopify, or other platforms to ensure design feasibility and proper handoff.

• Maintain consistent brand identity across all digital materials.

• Provide creative input and propose design improvements as needed.

• Proven experience in website design and branding.

• Strong portfolio showcasing brand development and modern website design projects.

• Experience designing for Webflow, Shopify, or similar platforms.

• Understanding of UI/UX best practices and responsive design principles.

• Highly creative with a strong eye for detail.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Sobre a vaga

A dhauz, empresa do grupo Quantum Rise, é empresa de serviços e soluções usando dados e inteligência artificial para suportar processos de tomada de decisão de negócios. Somos uma equipe interdisciplinar de profissionais formados nas melhores universidades do país e do exterior, com ampla experiência no mercado e prontos para auxiliar a transformação analítica de grandes marcas. Engenharia de dados, tecnologia, processos e pessoas combinados da melhor maneira para cada necessidade do seu projeto.

E aí, curtiu? #VemSerUmHauzer

Quem estamos procurando

Estamos procurando um(a) desenvolvedor(a) fullstack para integrar nosso time de desenvolvimento. Nosso objetivo é criar soluções analíticas customizadas para os clientes, com foco em boas práticas de engenharia, qualidade e sustentabilidade. Nossa stack atual inclui Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS e PostgreSQL. Combinamos conhecimento sólido em tecnologia com a aceleração promovida por ferramentas de AI/LLM.

Procuramos alguém que goste de um ambiente com alto nível técnico, com espaço real para aprender, ensinar e construir boas práticas.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Colaborar desde a definição da arquitetura até a entrega e sustentação da solução
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades, tomar decisões técnicas e entregar código limpo e de alta qualidade
  • Construir APIs seguras, performáticas e bem documentadas
  • Implementar interfaces intuitivas e com boa experiência de navegação
  • Apoiar a especificação da ferramenta, traduzindo regras de negócio e layout de telas em soluções claras e consistentes

Requisitos (o que esperamos que você tenha)

  • Experiência com Next.js (fullstack)
  • Experiência na construção de APIs
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL)
  • Experiência com front-end para aplicações web (especialmente React)
  • Experiência com Git e fluxo de versionamento
  • Inglês para conversação

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Cloud (principalmente AWS)
  • Experiência com CI/CD
  • Experiência com Docker
  • Experiência com Autenticação e Autorização

Tipo de contratação:

✅ Regime CLT ou PJ

✅100% Remoto

Benefícios CLT:

  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis Flash (alimentação/refeição);

title: Professor de Inglês e Espanhol
description:
Role Description

This is a remote contract role for a Professor of English and Spanish. The primary responsibilities include planning and delivering high-quality lessons, ensuring students' language learning progress, and creating an engaging and effective educational environment. The role also involves evaluating students' performance and providing constructive feedback to support their development.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in English Teaching and Spanish instruction
  • Experience in Lesson Planning and curriculum development
  • Professional background in Education and Teaching
  • Exceptional Communication skills to engage and mentor students effectively
  • Ability to work independently in a remote teaching environment
  • Prior experience teaching online or using virtual platforms is a plus
  • Relevant certifications in language teaching (e.g., TEFL, TESOL, or equivalent)
  • Passion for language education and cultural exchange

title: Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration .


In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate resilient OT-IT data pipelines across SCADA/MES and enterprise systems. Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), model/govern industrial data, and deliver secure batch and streaming integrations on prem and in the cloud.

  • End to end pipelines: Design, implement, and operate batch/streaming flows from SCADA, MES, and Historians to cloud/enterprise (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is plus.
  • UNS & modeling: Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), data modeling, and metadata management; ensure data quality, lineage, and governance.
  • Industrial integration: Connect (Ignition, HighByte, HiveMQ advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/consume RESTful APIs and connectors for SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.

description:

  • Apoiar as rotinas de folha de pagamento em interface com a contabilidade, realizando conferências e alinhamentos

  • Sólida experiência em rotinas de Departamento Pessoal
  • Sólida experiência em Recrutamento e Seleção
  • Conhecimento prático em folha de pagamento, benefícios, admissões e desligamentos
  • Organização, boa comunicação e senso de responsabilidade

Perfil comportamental:

  • Perfil proativo e comunicativo
  • Atitude positiva e energia para atuar em ambiente dinâmico
  • Espírito colaborativo e facilidade para trabalho em equipe
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Modalidade: Presencial
  • Local: Vila Maria – Zona Norte de São Paulo
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 07h00 às 17h00

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration Lead (RTR)
description:
SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration Lead (RTR)

Greenfield Implementation | Data Governance | GL, Cost Center, Profit Center

We are hiring for the position from North America

12 months contract role ; May extend

Remote

Candidate need to have Short notice period

Candidate need to use own personal computer for work

Candidate need to support EST time zone for meetings

We pay monthly in US Dollars ; No benefits ; Wire transfer

Fulltime contract role ; 40hrs a week; 8 hrs a day

Candidate should have expertise with Governance as a data owner, Fixed Assets/Projects experience, and Inventory experience. Would also like the candidates to have strong experience on Greenfield data migration (validation, problem resolution).

Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership

Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.

Required Qualifications

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.

Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

Candidates should have good decision making skills

Taking ownership of the project- Cutover process, mapping, testing, validation, conversion - master data

Would like someone hand-on but also functional - Mapping and testing of the conversion.

Set up cost center and cc groups, profit center groups

MGD experience helpful, need to know how to do it.

Product Costing - 1 FTE

Intercompany - 1 FTE

Financial Data / GL / Allocations - 2 FTE

Projects / WBS - 1 FTE

title: Senior Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Architect .


In this role you will:

Lead architecture and delivery of systems that unify OT and IT across SCADA/MES and enterprise platforms. Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), govern industrial data models, and enable secure, scalable batch/streaming integrations on‑prem and in the cloud.

  • Architect and design end‑to‑end OT→IT data integrations (batch/streaming) from SCADA, MES, Historians to enterprise/cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is a plus.
  • Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), industrial data modeling, and metadata management; enforce data quality, lineage, governance, and security-by-design.
  • Integrate industrial platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ, HighByte advantageous) via OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/govern RESTful APIs and connectors for SAP, SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Define and socialize application/integration/infrastructure standards, lead architecture for enterprise IT and digital transformation in regulated manufacturing.
  • Deploy/support enterprise applications with reliability, compliance, and operability, design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Perform schema design and performance tuning across SQL/NoSQL datastores.
  • Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts (diagrams, process/sequence flows, specifications); provide guidance to cross‑functional delivery teams.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelor’s in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Proactive, detail‑oriented collaborator in agile, cross‑functional environments.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Analista de Implementação - SAAS (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implementação - SAAS (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica;
  • Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana;
  • Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência;
  • Participar de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros;
  • Abertura de demandas técnicas para os times internos;
  • Apoiar na instalação da solução e nas atualizações dos ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e com acompanhamento do time mais experiente;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar implementação de projetos, garantindo histórico claro, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com os clientes durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, informando status, próximos passos e orientações.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional;
  • Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes;
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

  • Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica;
  • Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana;
  • Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência;

title: Mid–Senior C# Backend Engineer
description:
Company Description

DevOps Collab connects U.S.-based companies with highly skilled and motivated software engineers from Latin America. We specialize in helping businesses scale their technical teams efficiently and cost-effectively. By partnering with DevOps Collab, companies gain access to top-tier talent, while engineers benefit from competitive opportunities and improved earnings. Our commitment is to facilitate seamless collaboration and impactful technology solutions.

Role Description

We are seeking a Mid-Senior C# Backend Engineer for a remote contract role. The position involves designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance backend systems and applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and implement scalable solutions. Day-to-day duties include backend development, implementing object-oriented programming principles, optimizing application performance, and contributing to system architecture discussions.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Back-End Web Development and Software Development
  • Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and practices
  • Some exposure to Front-End Development is a plus
  • Experience and expertise in C# and general Programming skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in remote teams
  • Prior experience in cloud technologies and distributed systems is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

title: Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist position focuses on serving as the owner of ML algorithms powering campaign segmentation and targeting systems. This role is central to product success, managing massive systems with millions of data points and ensuring models directly impact business outcomes while optimizing, supervising, and evolving ML pipelines to drive innovation and reliability in critical platform components.

Key responsibilities:

- Optimizing existing machine learning algorithms to improve accuracy and performance.

- Proposing, designing, and implementing new ML features that enhance product capabilities.

- Supervising and monitoring machine learning performance at scale.

- Defining ML requirements and collaborating with engineering and product personnel to bring them to life.

- Handling administrative and organizational duties related to ML initiatives.

Requirements:

- ML Experience: 5+ years of comprehensive experience in Machine Learning, including at least 4 years building end-to-end model development lifecycles (requirements definition, feature discovery, model training/registration, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps).

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong knowledge of data and ML frameworks.

- Statistical Foundation: Solid fundamentals in probability and statistics.

- Business Acumen: Business-minded approach with proven stakeholder management skills — able to define work based on conversations with senior leaders.

- Product Mindset: Product-oriented perspective: designing ML pipelines with direct business impact and thriving in ownership-heavy environments.

- Development Practices: Familiarity with development best practices and navigating complex production codebases.

- Education: Postgraduate degree in Machine Learning or Data Science.

Additional skills preferred:

- Databricks Platform: Experience with Databricks environment.

- ML Explainability: Experience implementing machine learning explainability pipelines.

- Orchestration Tools: Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Marketing Applications: Experience applying machine learning to marketing use cases.

What to expect from us:

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves.

- Professional Development: English classes and Udemy for Business access.

- Financial Benefits: Personal loans with 0% interest following company policies.

- Competitive Compensation: Payment well above market average.

- Growth Opportunities: Develop at the speed of your learning curve.

- Innovation-Driven Environment: Support and resources for professional growth in diverse, multicultural environment.

- Game-Changing Opportunity: Resources to make significant impact in a fast-growing company.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process ✅

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process ✅

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

title: Senior Software Developer | .NET | C# | Windows Applications
description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our LATAM Solutions Team and support the development of the next generation of our innovative products, leveraging cutting-edge AI and Machine Learning technologies.

This professional will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining customized software solutions on a Windows-based platform, contributing to high-impact digital transformation projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using C# and .NET.
  • Build and customize solutions on a Windows PC-based platform.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate AI/ML capabilities into products.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure high-quality standards through testing, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Optimize system performance, scalability, and security.
  • Contribute to technical decisions and architecture improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in software development.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET.
  • Solid experience developing applications for Windows environments.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 level or higher).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment.

About Genesis Consulting

Genesis Consulting is a global technology consulting company focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions, helping organizations transform through innovation, strategy, and technology.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (JavaScript / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with comprehensive knowledge of JavaScript to join the software engineering team for our US-based client.

This client saves its customers millions of dollars providing engineering services, consulting, and software for complex, global projects in the renewable energy and oil and gas industries. The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO

Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!

Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.

Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.

Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.

Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!

Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.

Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!

Sobre o Cargo

  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.

Requisitos

  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.

Modelo de Contratação

  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.

Etapas de Seleção

  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos uma pessoa com forte visão arquitetural e estratégica para atuar na reestruturação do ecossistema Salesforce. Nessa posição, você será responsável por desenhar soluções que equilibrem necessidades regulatórias com as melhores práticas de engenharia, garantindo uma arquitetura escalável, sustentável e alinhada aos objetivos do negócio. Seu desafio será liderar tecnicamente a evolução da plataforma, promovendo soluções eficientes e reduzindo a dívida técnica.

Responsabilidades:

✔ Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de abstração dentro do ecossistema Salesforce.

✔ Liderar tecnicamente processos de migração e reestruturação de módulos críticos sob pressão de prazos regulatórios.

✔ Garantir o uso estratégico dos recursos nativos do Salesforce (Vanilla), minimizando customizações desnecessárias e reduzindo dívida técnica.

✔ Definir padrões arquiteturais e boas práticas para evolução sustentável da plataforma.

✔ Colaborar com lideranças e stakeholders para alinhar as entregas técnicas aos prazos e necessidades do negócio.

✔ Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à refatoração e modernização de componentes do ecossistema Salesforce.

Requisitos:

✔ Experiência sênior com Salesforce, com domínio profundo da plataforma.

✔ Capacidade de desenhar camadas de abstração com código e configuração flexíveis e reutilizáveis.

✔ Conhecimento sólido sobre uso de recursos nativos do Salesforce versus desenvolvimento customizado (Apex e LWC).

✔ Experiência em projetos de reestruturação, refatoração ou migração de instâncias complexas da plataforma.

✔ Vivência em ambientes de alta criticidade e prazos desafiadores.

Diferenciais:

➕ Experiência com arquitetura de soluções em ambientes regulados.

➕ Certificações Salesforce voltadas à arquitetura ou desenvolvimento.

➕ Experiência em projetos de transformação ou modernização de plataformas CRM.

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

title: Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor  - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor will ensure the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review junior auditors' work, and help align evaluation criteria across the team, driving continuous improvement in hiring processes.


Key Responsibilities:


- Executing complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervising and reviewing Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Leading calibration calls and standardizing criteria across the audit team.


Requirements:


- Experience: 5+ years in Quality Assurance roles

- Audit Expertise: Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions

- Leadership: Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations

- Language: Advanced proficiency in English


Desirable Skills:


- Talent Acquisition: Experience in recruitment processes

- Process Management: Experience with high-volume recruitment

- Technical Skills: Data analysis and SQL experience


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.

Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).

Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.

Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ

Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta

Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de DevOps, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, FastAPI ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;

title: Senior JD Edwards E1 Developer (Brazil Localization & Integration Specialist)
description:
Full-time | Remote Primary Hubs: Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay

Secondary Hubs: Colombia, Chile

About Allari

Allari is a global technology solutions provider specializing in high-impact JD Edwards ecosystems. We value deep technical expertise and proactive problem-solving, helping our clients navigate complex regulatory and trade landscapes across the globe.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the \"plumbing\" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

Core Specialized Requirements

  • Localization & Trade Integration: Proven experience managing the interface between JDE and external Tax/Global Trade platforms.
  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.
  • Fiscal Logic : A deep functional understanding of Brazilian tax calculation (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS) and its impact on Procurement, Sales, and the General Ledger.
  • JDE Orchestrator : Advanced proficiency in building and troubleshooting Orchestrations (including Groovy scripting) for real-time external integrations.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Core JDE Development: Expert-level mastery of RDA, FDA, BDA, TDA, and C BSFNs.
  • Integration Protocols: High comfort level with Business Services (BSSV), REST/SOAP APIs, and EDI/Flat File processing.
  • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a \"Technical-Functional Bridge,\" understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the \"connectors\" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).
  • English: Intermediate / Preferred. (We prioritize your technical-functional JDE expertise over absolute fluency).
  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.

Apply with your CV in English.
